files.prompt: Photorealistic workplace safety training photo, 16:9 landscape. Setting: a clean, modern food-production plant with stainless steel equipment and natural overhead plant lighting. Subject: a maintenance technician wearing a blue bump cap, white hairnet, clear safety glasses, gloves, no jewelry, standing beside a STOPPED stainless conveyor. He is attaching a red padlock and a blank red-and-white danger tag to the handle of a grey wall-mounted electrical disconnect switch set to OFF. His hands are only on the disconnect, well away from the belt and all moving parts. Constraints: no readable text anywhere, no logos, no hard hats, no lock on any button or panel, no one touching the conveyor.
files.safety_check: pass (minor: technician has light stubble without a beard net; disconnect handle position reads ambiguous ON/OFF)
